'''Attark''' was a [[Hoover/Legends|Hoover]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he was the pet of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in the latter's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Attark was a [[Technician/Legends|technician]], whose small size allowed him to both manipulate electronic equipment and crawl inside machinery to repair it from within. Despite his harmless appearance, at [[Standard day/Legends|night time]] Attark would creep up on [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] victims to suck their [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], Attark was present in Jabba's palace when several allies of Jabba's [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] to bargain for Solo's freedom. Those events led to the collapse of Jabba's [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] himself, and it was unknown if Attark survived.

==Biography==
[[File:Attark_SWI_60.jpg|250px|thumb|left|Attark stayed in Jabba the Hutt's palace on Tatooine.]]
The [[Hoover/Legends|Hoover]] Attark lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CCG" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Attark joined the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], staying in the crime lord's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> as a pet of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|47|Attark}}</ref> Attark worked as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]], and his small size allowed him to easily manipulate detailed electronic equipment,<ref name="CCG" /> as well as crawl inside machinery and repair it from within.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Despite looking harmless, Attark would creep up on [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] victims to suck their [[Blood/Legends|blood]] at [[Standard day/Legends|night]], using his [[Nose/Legends|nose]] trunk to slither through [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] or around [[Blanket/Legends|blankets]].<ref name="CSWE" />

In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Attark was present in the Hutt's palace<ref name="Who's Who" /> when several Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] to bargain for the freedom of their ally, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] in the palace. Those events ultimately led to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Jabba and the dissolution of his criminal empire.<ref name="NEC" /> It was unknown if Attark survived those events.<ref name="Guide to SWU" />

==Personality and traits==
Attark possessed tremendous technical abilities,<ref name="CCG" /> and his small size also aided his work as a technician.<ref name="CCG" /><ref name="Who's Who" /> Attark would also suck the blood of sleeping victims, while using his nose to slither around protective layers.<ref name="CSWE" /> Attark possessed [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hoover_bts.jpg|thumb|right|An early color scheme for Attark]]
Attark's origins come from a maquette created for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]; however, the creature is not visible in the film nor can its presence be recalled by several of the puppeteers from the set.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref> The character was given the moniker "Hoover" by the creature shop of [[Industrial Light & Magic]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> from as early as [[1981]].<ref name="Blog" /> The nickname was perhaps acknowledging his resemblance to the [[Wikipedia:The Hoover Company|Hoover]] vacuum cleaner.<ref name="Who's Who" /> A second nickname found in Attark's original design sketches was "Dogephant." The puppet was to be operated by puppeteer<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> [[Swim Lee]]'s<ref name="Swim Lee">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsautographcollecting.com/Autographs/StarWarsTrilogy/ROJ/SweeLim.htm|text=Trilogy Autographs|work=Dahoov's Autograph Collecting|archivedate=20060521141717}}</ref> arm through the floor. A dummy maquette shows that propmakers considered painting him a light purple with red spots on his back, before later being colored brown.<ref name="SWC" /> The maquette ended up in the [[Lucasfilm]] Archives sporting a blonde [[Wig/Legends|wig]].<ref name="Blog" />

Reference books such as 1983's ''[[Return of the Jedi Monster Activity Book]]'',<ref name="Activity book">''[[Return of the Jedi Monster Activity Book]]''</ref> [[1994]]'s ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''<ref name="Guide to SWU" /> and [[1997]]'s [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']], treated Hoover as the character's name, leaving his [[Species/Legends|species]] unidentified.<ref name="SWC" /> In [[1998]], the character was first identified as Attark, of the Hoover species, for a card in the "[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]" expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" /> In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' gave entries for both Attark<ref name="CSWE" /> and Hoover; however, it treated Hoover as a member of the Hoover species, and a separate character from Attark.<ref name="CSWE57">{{CSWECite|II|57|Hoover}}</ref> This article assumes the Hoover entry is in error.
